title: Mahadev betting case: ED records TV host Shefali Bagga's statement
summary: Television host Shefali Bagga was questioned by the ED on Thursday in connection with its money laundering investigation into the alleged ₹6,000 crore Mahadev online betting app case. The agency recorded her statement under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA).
